supersedes: pre-ADR work items naming the superseded coordination backend

tasks.objective: Define the CAL SQLite schema (tasks, deps, events, runs, comments, attachments) and dataclasses; WAL mode; versioned, idempotent migration hooks; connection management.

acceptance_tests.method: Create the store on an empty file and inspect PRAGMA journal_mode.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Schema creates without error and journal_mode is 'wal'.

acceptance_tests.method: Round-trip a task with deps, events, runs, comments and one attachment record through the models.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: All records persist and reload with identical fields.

acceptance_tests.method: Run the schema migration step twice.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: The second run is a no-op and reports no pending migrations.

tasks.objective: Implement CAL kanban core: task CRUD, DAG edges with cycle rejection, lifecycle transitions, atomic claim (single SQLite transaction with lock + TTL), review lifecycle, artifact registration, diagnostics.

acceptance_tests.method: Create a child task with a parent and complete the parent.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Child stays 'todo' until the parent completes, then promotes to 'ready'.

acceptance_tests.method: Attempt a self-link and a 3-node cycle.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Both are rejected; the graph remains acyclic.

acceptance_tests.method: Claim the same ready task from two concurrent callers.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Exactly one claim wins; the other is refused.

acceptance_tests.method: Run request-review then request-changes then complete.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Each transition is recorded as an event with the expected state change.

tasks.objective: Implement the CAL workspace manager: worktree create/cleanup/status, deterministic configurable branch naming, preserve worktrees for blocked/review tasks.

acceptance_tests.method: Create a worktree for a task id.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Path is <repo>/.worktrees/<task-id> on branch <project-slug>/<task-id>.

acceptance_tests.method: Clean up the worktree, then attempt cleanup of a blocked task's worktree.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Normal cleanup removes the directory; the blocked task's worktree is preserved.

tasks.objective: Implement the CAL hotspot index: scan recent completion metadata, index hotspots, detect collisions against active worktrees' git diff --name-only.

acceptance_tests.method: Feed two completions declaring the same file plus one worktree diff touching it.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: A collision is reported for that file.

acceptance_tests.method: Feed a set with no overlap.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Zero collisions; output is valid JSON.

tasks.objective: Implement the CAL scheduler: dispatcher loop with claim, spawn via 'cal kanban spawn', heartbeat monitor, reclaim on stale heartbeat or dead PID, configurable interval, no failure penalty for timeout/staleness.

acceptance_tests.method: Kill a running worker (kill -9) and observe the loop.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Task is reclaimed to 'ready' and completes on respawn without incrementing the failure counter.

acceptance_tests.method: Exit a worker cleanly without a terminal call.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: A protocol-violation event is recorded and the task is re-queued.

tasks.objective: Implement the CAL CLI exposing kanban, workspace, hotspot, scheduler, migrate, diag, stats, watch, runs, backup, repair.

acceptance_tests.method: Run 'cal <subcommand> --help' for every documented subcommand.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: All parse and render help without error.

acceptance_tests.method: Exercise cal kanban create/show/complete/request-review/block against cal.db.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: State changes are persisted and observable.

acceptance_tests.method: Run 'cal diag --severity error --json' and 'cal stats'.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Both return structured output.

tasks.objective: Implement the CAL migration importer: import tasks, deps, events, runs, comments and attachments from the legacy coordination store with a --dry-run mode and count fidelity.

acceptance_tests.method: Run the importer with --dry-run.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Per-table source/expected counts are reported and nothing is written.

acceptance_tests.method: Run the importer for real, then run it again.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Counts match the source; the second run is idempotent.

acceptance_tests.method: Run the CAL test suite from a clean checkout.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: All tests pass.

acceptance_tests.method: Map each ADR-010 section 13.2 criterion to a test.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: worktree isolation, reclaim, protocol-violation detection, review gate, hotspot detection, observability and no-secrets each have a passing test.

acceptance_tests.method: sdlc-tester reproduces the run independently.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Same result observed; no fabricated evidence.

acceptance_tests.method: Search both files for legacy launcher invocations and legacy store path references.

definition_of_done: All work items WI-01 through WI-16 are completed with acceptance tests executed and evidence recorded.
tools/cal/ exists with the full cal CLI surface and a green test suite.
kanban_tools.py, agent_workspace.py, spawn-agent.sh and detect-hotspots.py import/call CAL and contain zero superseded-backend CLI invocations and zero legacy on-disk store path references.
cal migrate imports all tasks, deps, events, runs, comments and attachments with matching counts, and the board is served from cal.db.
A pilot feature runs end-to-end on CAL with zero superseded-backend invocations.
All ADR-010 section 13.2 acceptance criteria pass on CAL.
ADR-010, the research report and the tooling README reference CAL; no prescriptive legacy commands remain in them.
Security gate finds no secrets/PII in cal.db, artifacts or CLI output.
The release gate passes and the human release gate is preserved.
No approved architectural decision was silently changed; no unintentional files were modified.
Independence verification of this plan returns zero matches for the superseded backend name.
rollback_notes: CAL is additive (tools/cal/ is a new directory); until WI-14 cutover the legacy coordination store remains the source of truth, so all P0/P1/P2 work is revertible without state loss.

After cutover, rollback is: repoint the board to the legacy store (it is retained, not deleted, until WI-16 completes) and revert the tooling refactor commits in reverse dependency order (WI-12 -> WI-11 -> WI-10 -> WI-09).
The migration importer (WI-07) must never delete or mutate the legacy store; it only reads. This keeps cutover reversible.
cal.db is a critical asset: schedule 'cal backup' before WI-14 and before WI-16; keep the pre-cutover backup until the human release gate approves.
Do not remove tools/cal/ while WI-09..WI-16 depend on it; revert only after all dependent work items are complete or reverted in reverse dependency order.
Rollback notes are planning guidance only; no destructive command is authorized by this plan.
